KFAC.description: Effective Length Factor (KFAC). Each entry is keyed by an integer id and holds the effective length factors used in steel/RC/SRC member design; all three factors default to 1.0 when omitted.

Ky.description: Effective length factor about the member's local y-axis (weak-axis buckling). Optional; defaults to 1.0.

Kz.description: Effective length factor about the member's local z-axis (strong-axis buckling). Optional; defaults to 1.0.

Kt.description: Effective length factor for torsional/lateral-torsional buckling. Optional; defaults to 1.0.
